copied.text: We agreed to move the spring planting day to the second Saturday of April because the soil delivery slipped.
Ben said he will confirm the soil delivery date with the supplier by Wednesday.
I will draft the volunteer rota for planting day and share it before the next call.
We are still not sure whether the school group can join on the planting day.
One idea was to add a small herb spiral beside the shed if there is soil left over.
I will also email the council about the tap repair warranty this week.

quick.text: Send Ben the supplier's phone number [q1]
Share the call notes with Carla

scopes.done_when: the rota is shared with the group
